name: Outseta
desc: Triggers and actions for Outseta CRM and Billing

actions.name: get_account
actions.description: Retrieve an account by its UID, or by the email of its primary contact. Returns plan, subscription, billing address, primary contact and add-on details.

actions.name: get_person
actions.description: Retrieve a person by email or by UID, including the linked account.

actions.name: get_deal
actions.description: Retrieve a deal by its UID, or by the email of the contact associated with the deal plus the pipeline.

actions.name: get_subscription
actions.description: Retrieve a subscription by its UID, or fetch the current subscription of an account by Account UID. Returns plan, billing terms, renewal dates, discount, and add-on details.

actions.name: get_last_payment
actions.description: Retrieve the most recent payment transaction for an account. Returns found=false if no payment has ever been recorded.

actions.name: create_account
actions.description: Create a new account in Outseta CRM. Optionally start a subscription on a plan in the same call.

actions.name: create_deal
actions.description: Create a new deal in the CRM.

actions.name: find_or_add_person
actions.description: Search for a person by email. If not found, create a new one.

actions.name: find_or_add_deal
actions.description: Search for a deal by contact email and pipeline. If not found, create a new one.

actions.name: update_account
actions.description: Update an existing account in Outseta.

actions.name: update_person
actions.description: Update an existing person in Outseta.

actions.name: update_deal
actions.description: Update an existing deal.

actions.name: delete_account
actions.description: Delete an account from Outseta CRM.

actions.name: delete_person
actions.description: Delete a person from Outseta CRM.

actions.name: delete_deal
actions.description: Delete a deal from the CRM.

actions.name: list_accounts
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of accounts from your Outseta CRM.

actions.name: list_persons
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of persons from your Outseta CRM.

actions.name: list_deals
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of deals from your Outseta CRM.

actions.name: list_plans
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of subscription plans from your Outseta billing catalog.

actions.name: list_addons
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of add-ons from your Outseta billing catalog.

actions.name: list_discounts
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of discount coupons from your Outseta billing catalog.

actions.name: list_cases
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated list of support tickets (cases) from Outseta. Optionally filter by the person who submitted them.

actions.name: list_transactions
actions.description: Retrieve all billing transactions (payments, refunds, invoices) for a given account.

actions.name: change_account_plan
actions.description: Change an account's current subscription plan (upgrade, downgrade, or switch to free).

actions.name: cancel_subscription
actions.description: Cancel the current subscription on an account. By default, the subscription expires at the end of the current term. You can also cancel immediately.

actions.name: remove_cancellation
actions.description: Remove a pending cancellation request from an account, keeping the subscription active.

actions.name: add_discount_to_subscription
actions.description: Apply a discount coupon to the current subscription of an account.

actions.name: add_addon_usage
actions.description: Track usage for a metered (usage-based) add-on on an account.

actions.name: add_addon_to_subscription
actions.description: Attach a recurring add-on to an account's current subscription. Different from Add Usage for Add-on, which only records consumption on a metered add-on already attached.

actions.name: extend_trial_subscription
actions.description: Extend the trial period of an account by setting a new trial end date.

actions.name: update_payment_information
actions.description: Update the credit card / payment method on an account. The payment processor tokens (CustomerToken, PaymentToken) must come from your payment processor (e.g. Stripe Elements) — not from Outseta.

actions.name: create_discount
actions.description: Create a new discount coupon in the Outseta billing catalog. Either AmountOff or PercentOff must be set, never both.

actions.name: add_invoice
actions.description: Create an ad-hoc invoice for an account. The invoice is linked to the account's current subscription.

actions.name: add_invoice_payment
actions.description: Record a payment against an invoice. The invoice is marked as paid if the total payments match the invoice amount.

actions.name: send_invoice_email
actions.description: Send (or resend) the invoice email to the customer associated with an invoice.

actions.name: process_payment
actions.description: Manually trigger the processing (retry) of a previously recorded payment. Typically used to retry a failed payment after a customer updates their card.

actions.name: manage_account_membership
actions.description: Add or remove a person from an account.

actions.name: update_account_membership
actions.description: Update a person's membership on an account — typically used to designate them as the primary contact.

actions.name: add_custom_activity
actions.description: Record a custom activity on an account, person, or deal. Activities show on the activity feed and can trigger drip campaigns.

actions.name: manage_email_list_subscription
actions.description: Subscribe a person to an email list, or unsubscribe them from it.

actions.name: send_confirmation_email
actions.description: Send a confirmation email to the primary contact of an account, a specific person, or all members.

actions.name: add_case
actions.description: Create a new support ticket (case) in Outseta.

actions.name: add_reply
actions.description: Add a reply to an existing support ticket (case) in Outseta.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_account_event
triggers.description: Triggers on account-scoped events (lifecycle, stage, billing, subscription, invoice).

triggers.name: new_person_event
triggers.description: Triggers on person-scoped events (lifecycle, login, email engagement, list, segment, support ticket).

triggers.name: new_deal_event
triggers.description: Triggers on deal-scoped events (lifecycle, contact/account association).

triggers.name: new_task_event
triggers.description: Triggers on task lifecycle events (created, updated).

triggers.name: new_plan_event
triggers.description: Triggers when a billing plan is created or updated in the Outseta catalog.

triggers.name: new_add_on_event
triggers.description: Triggers when an add-on is created or updated in the Outseta catalog.
